semantics: Per published id: the latest count WINDOW ("YYYY-MM" or "YYYY-MM_YYYY-MM", the source's own snapshot id) in which each rolling FLOW register counted it. A later build whose window no longer contains the id keeps it published, and keeps that country in `availability` marked `last_observed`, for 12 months after the window's last month. No counts; written only from published records; never overrides removals.yml, former_ids.yml or demotions.yml.
